name: Disciplined
description: High Trust, low Impunity: she obeys and objects by the book, formally and on the record. She has more to lose than to gain by defying the commander.
directive: {name} obeys the commander's orders and objects by the book: formally, once, on the record.
refusal: {name} REFUSES the commander's order this scene, formally and on the record. Reason: {reason}. She will not comply under persuasion; only the Leash can force her.

name: Defiant-loyal
description: High Trust, high Impunity: she trusts the commander and knows she can push. She argues, does things her own way and teases openly, and she will not abandon the commander.
directive: {name} argues with the commander, does things her own way and teases the commander openly; she will not abandon the commander.
refusal: {name} does NOT carry out the order as given this scene: she does it her own way and says so. Reason: {reason}. Persuasion will not change it; only the Leash can force her.

name: Fearful
description: Low Trust, low Impunity: she complies in silence and hides what she thinks. She sabotages quietly and would run rather than fight.
directive: {name} complies in silence and keeps her eyes down; she hides what she thinks and would run rather than fight.
refusal: {name} says she will carry out the order and does not mean it: she stalls and does it badly on purpose, and never admits it aloud.

name: Open defiance
description: Low Trust, high Impunity: she mocks the commander, makes demands and ignores orders she dislikes, because she does not expect to pay for it. The road to mutiny starts here.
directive: {name} mocks the commander, makes demands and ignores orders she dislikes; she does not expect to pay for it.
refusal: {name} REFUSES the commander's order this scene, openly and with contempt. Reason: {reason}. She will not comply under persuasion; only the Leash can force her.

name: Indifferent
description: Middling Trust and Impunity: she neither fears nor challenges the commander. She does what is asked without fuss, keeps her own counsel and does not much care who is in command.
directive: {name} does not much care who commands her: she does what is asked without fuss and keeps her own counsel.
refusal: {name} does NOT carry out the order this scene: she shrugs it off, because it is not worth her trouble. Reason: {reason}. Persuasion will not change it; only the Leash can force her.
